narrative: Partial easing of the Strait of Hormuz transit risk over the weekend anchors the market backdrop, though lingering geopolitical caution and a surprise Treasury buyback set up a complex Tokyo open. NZD/USD closed Friday at 0.5978, leading the G10 (NZD 1W avg: +1.252%, USD 1W avg: -1.315%, G10 spread: 2.567%) as softening Fed hike bets likely continue to weigh on the USD. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1678; while technicals remain constructive, the pair faces local sentiment headwinds ahead of Thursday’s RBNZ rate decision.
